sample_unit: surgical medical students, residents, and consultants/specialists

links.outcome: Proportion of surgical trainees and specialists with formal AI training and AI/ChatGPT literacy
links.effect: 93.2% of participants lacked formal AI training; 80.9% had prior ChatGPT experience; consultants reported lower familiarity than trainees; lack of training was a reported barrier.
links.quote: Most participants lacked formal AI training (93.2%), but 80.9% had prior ChatGPT experience.

screen.reason: The study is an empirical survey assessing AI and ChatGPT literacy, attitudes, and perceived barriers among surgical medical students, residents, and consultants.
